name: Data Analyst
question: Can you ship a correct report?
challenge: messy data → reliable model → validated dashboard
summary: You turn a business question and a messy export into a model and a report that a manager can trust. Correctness beats polish.

name: BI Developer
question: Can other people safely build on your work?
challenge: individual report → reusable organizational BI asset
summary: Your model becomes something other people depend on: shared, secured, refreshed on a schedule and documented well enough that nobody has to ask you.

name: Senior BI Developer
question: Can you diagnose and fix what breaks?
challenge: symptom → evidence → root cause → fix → prevention
summary: Things go wrong in production: slow reports, numbers that disagree, refreshes that fail. You find the cause with evidence, fix it and stop it coming back.

name: BI Engineer
question: Can you ship BI changes safely at scale?
challenge: change → review → validate → deploy → observe → roll back if needed
summary: Changes go through Git, review, automated checks and promotion between environments. You can deploy on a Friday because you can roll back.

name: BI Architect / Lead
question: Can you make the right organizational decision?
challenge: multiple valid options → constraints → trade-offs → recommendation → decision
summary: There is no single right answer any more. You weigh cost, latency, risk and people, write the decision down, and explain it to a CFO and an engineer in their own words.
